description: This file is a CMake module script for locating and configuring the CUDA Deep Neural Network library (cuDNN) within a CMake build system. It defines variables, options, and logic to identify the cuDNN include directories, library files, and extract version information, helping to ensure proper linkage and inclusion during build configuration.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Searches for the cudnn.h header file in given hints and suffixes.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Finds the cuDNN library file in specified paths.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles standard logic for package configuration, reports success or failure based on required components.
